title: Metal transformations
description: A datapack which adds mostly create mod haunting recipies for reverting various metals into their previous states.
body: This is a data pack which mostly adds haunting recipies for haunting various materials to revert them with some smelting recipies. To not make this op to get infinite quartz/clay/redstone/gunpowder with a crushing washing compacting haunting set-up, it's not a 100% chance for the items to revert. (50% to retrive all items from ingot, 75% to retrive all items from block)
